summary: Frontend-only regression on the reworked LEAD DETAIL cockpit (#/leads/{id}). Logged in as admin@crm.local and exercised all interaction flows on Vikram Nair (lead id=1). Cockpit renders as a full-page 3-column layout (data-testid=lead-cockpit; grid template on desktop 300px / 752px / 340px). The old right-side drawer is gone (data-testid=lead-drawer not in DOM). All required testids are present in header, left rail, main column and right rail. All flows (actions dropdown, recalc, stage change, note add, communicate sub-tab, WA template picker, qualify modal, module modals, schedule-visit, back button) work with ZERO JS console errors and ZERO pageerror events.

issues: Uses browser-native datetime-local input (mm/dd/yyyy --:--) instead of a styled/shadcn-like calendar picker. Not a blocker but slightly inconsistent with the modern feel of the cockpit rework.

flows_verified.actions-dropdown: lead-actions-btn opens lead-actions-menu with recalc/enroll/dnc/invalid/won/lost. verify-btn correctly hidden because Vikram is already Verified=Yes. Clicking recalc-btn closes the menu and updates score bar (82 -> 95).
flows_verified.stage-change: stage-select changes pipeline stage (opportunity -> new_lead) and the timeline shows 'Status: opportunity -> new_lead' entry.
flows_verified.note-add: note-input + note-add appended 'TEST_note_cockpit_review' to the activity timeline immediately.
flows_verified.communicate-subtab: composer-tab-comm reveals call-outcome, call-log, wa-body, wa-template-btn, wa-send, em-subject, em-send. wa-template-btn triggered a template/toast response as expected.
flows_verified.qualify-modal: edit-qualify-btn opens a modal containing q-* selects (qualify form).
flows_verified.module-modals: mod-quote-open, mod-booking-open, mod-postsales-open each open a modal (data-testid=modal-overlay) with correct titles: 'Quote / Cost Sheet', 'Booking', 'Post-Sales'.
flows_verified.schedule-visit: schedule-visit-btn opens the 'Schedule Site Visit' modal with project + unit + meeting point fields.
flows_verified.regression: #/pipeline and #/dashboard both load successfully after cockpit interactions.
flows_verified.responsive: At 500px viewport the .lc grid collapses to a single column (grid-template-columns ~= 749px single track). At 1920px it renders as '300px 752px 340px' (3-col cockpit).
flows_verified.console-errors: Zero JS console errors and zero pageerror events across the entire session.

action_items: Optional/minor: consider replacing native datetime-local input in the Schedule Visit modal with a designed calendar component to match the cockpit's modern feel.

Optional: verify-btn only appears when lead is unverified; couldn't be exercised on seeded leads (all Verified=Yes). Consider seeding one unverified lead so this branch is testable in future regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: leads.js is ~744 lines - within acceptable size but approaching the 700-line guideline; if more grows here, consider extracting the header/actions/composer/module-card builders into separate small modules.
Modal helper CRM.modal uses custom .modal-overlay (not Bootstrap .modal.show). Worth noting in a short comment for future test authors so they use [data-testid="modal-overlay"] to detect open modals.
seed_data_creation: None. Added one test note on lead id=1 ('TEST_note_cockpit_review') and toggled stage back/forth during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead cockpit lives at /app/laravel-crm/public/assets/js/leads.js (openLead builds the full page). Modal helper is CRM.modal in api.js -> use [data-testid=modal-overlay] to assert modals are open (NOT .modal.show which is Bootstrap). Login submit button is text 'Sign in' - use page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). Seeded leads are ids 1-4; lead 1 (Vikram Nair) is Verified=Yes so verify-btn is hidden by design.
